patterns.note: A persistent three-column layout with sticky left and right sidebars flanking the main content area, providing constant access to global and local navigation.
Code examples are presented in distinct, bordered blocks using a monospace font, clearly differentiating them from the surrounding body text.
A vibrant blue is consistently used for primary interactive elements like links and the brand logo, providing clear visual cues against a largely neutral background.
Both the left global navigation sidebar and the right 'On this page' table of contents sidebar remain sticky as the user scrolls, keeping navigation always in view.
Sponsor sections are clearly delineated by tiers (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze), each with a distinct visual presentation for logos and associated text.

technique_notes: Implement a three-column grid where the left and right columns are fixed-width and use CSS `position: sticky` to keep them in place, while the central column is fluid and scrollable, containing the main content.
Use CSS `position: sticky` for the left navigation, right 'on this page' navigation, and a floating 'Ask AI' button, ensuring they remain in view as the user scrolls the main content.

Style code examples within distinct, slightly rounded, bordered containers with a contrasting background color and a dedicated monospace font, including a small copy-to-clipboard button in the corner.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately larger and bolder than body text, with a clear hierarchy; code blocks use a distinct monospace font at a slightly smaller size than body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and badges, with sharp corners for code blocks and main content sections.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with ample vertical spacing between sections and paragraphs, and tighter spacing within lists and navigation elements.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly functional and persistent three-column layout, which keeps both global and local navigation (table of contents) always visible alongside the main content. This creates an exceptionally efficient and focused reading experience for technical documentation.
